Mitchell Robinson said he doesn't care who starts at center for the Celtics or plays the most minutes. Robinson said he's comfortable coming off the bench or starting.

Robinson also said he's "shot a lot of free throws this offseason. A lot." And added that he feels great physically entering camp.
